Wizards official Avatar Last Airbender notes Drannith: opponent cannot cast from anywhere other than hand (https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/avatar-the-last-airbender-release-notes)

No suggestion that Ignus's mana ability can be countered, responded to or put on stack; opponents can answer spell on stack or act at earlier priority windows
Never claim Abaddon cascade trigger disappears just because commander was removed AFTER cast
Physically account hand Ignus when countered; if original on stack is countered before it resolves, cascade still operates but no postresolution bounce
Check all 99 physical zone identities and colored payments in each test
